title: Purchase Credit Against the Honored Quote by Price Type — Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
When a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket names the customer's own Marlowe & Finch purchase record, a purchase credit is taken off the honored amount, set by the price type of that purchase in Merchandise Purchases.

| Purchase record named on the ticket | Purchase credit taken off the honored amount |
|---|---|
| The customer's own purchase record at regular price | 3.00 USD |
| The customer's own purchase record at any other price type (sale, clearance, doorbuster, final sale) | 1.00 USD |
| No such record named | none |

**Record read.** The price type on the Merchandise Purchases record the ticket names.

## Hypothetical cases

- A suit bought at regular price, its purchase record named on the ticket: 3.00 USD off the honored amount.
- A gown bought at clearance, its purchase record named on the ticket: 1.00 USD off.
- A coat bought from another retailer, no purchase record named: no credit.
